tokens.name: outer
tokens.usage: Page background around the application frame on wide screens (1200px and above). Same value as `cyan` but a separate role: change one without the other.

tokens.name: shell
tokens.usage: Outer application frame and top bar only. Text and icons on it use `on-shell`.

tokens.name: on-shell
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `shell` (20:1) and on primary buttons filled with `ink` (17.9:1). Also the focus outline colour on dark surfaces. Added because the guide names white for these uses without a token.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Main application background inside the frame. Also the fill of the active navigation capsule in the top bar.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Reading surfaces, standard cards, inputs and lesson prose.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Search fields, quiet utility regions, placeholders, Coming soon and Not started badges, disabled buttons.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, body text and primary button fill. 17.93:1 on `surface`, 16.57:1 on `canvas`, 13.21:1 or better on every pastel. Also the code panel surface and the focus outline on light surfaces.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Explanatory text. 6.47:1 on `canvas`, 7.0:1 on `surface`, 5.16:1 on `lilac`, above 5:1 on every pastel. Also the hover fill of primary buttons (white on it is 7.0:1).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata on `canvas` (4.93:1), `surface` (5.33:1), `surface-muted` (4.58:1) and `cyan` (4.78:1) only. Fails 4.5:1 on `lilac`, `mint`, `butter` and `lavender`: use `text-secondary` there. On `shell` it meets 3:1 for borders, not for text.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Decorative separators and non-essential card outlines. Never the only boundary of a form control.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Input boundaries and meaningful outlined controls (secondary buttons). 4.95:1 on `surface`, 4.58:1 on `canvas`.

tokens.name: cyan
tokens.usage: Progress overview, orientation, In progress badges, Example and Context callouts, Project kit cards. Ink text 16.07:1.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Completed work and positive outcomes: Complete and Accepted badges, confirmed save messages, Checked outcome callouts. Ink text 15.01:1.

tokens.name: lilac
tokens.usage: Featured lesson and the Continue learning card. Stays lilac whatever the lesson status. Ink text 13.21:1.

tokens.name: butter
tokens.usage: Helpful guidance and attention needed: Awaiting review and Changes requested badges, Before you continue callouts, Templates cards. Ink text 14.82:1.

tokens.name: lavender
tokens.usage: Toolkit highlights and prompts: Prompt library cards, Submitted badges, avatar initials.

tokens.name: error-bg
tokens.usage: Error message and Could not save surfaces, destructive button fill.

tokens.name: error-ink
tokens.usage: Error text and meaningful error indicators, invalid field borders. 6.84:1 on `error-bg`, 7.86:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind the modal Help drawer and dialogs. Added: the guide places a modal backdrop in the layer order without a value.

styles.name: page-heading
styles.usage: Main page heading on Home, Syllabus, My work and Toolkit. Guide range 650 to 700.

styles.name: lesson-title
styles.usage: Full lesson title. Always wraps, never clipped. Guide range 650 to 700.

styles.name: section-heading
styles.usage: Page sections and lesson sections such as Your task and Knowledge check.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Card headings, including the Continue learning lesson title.

styles.name: lesson-subsection
styles.usage: Numbered teaching subsections inside a lesson.

styles.name: progress-figure
styles.usage: Meaningful progress counts only, always with a label and scope.

styles.name: lesson-body
styles.sample: Open the file and read the props first.

styles.name: dashboard-body
styles.sample: Pick up where you left off.
styles.usage: Dashboard and card body text. 400 to 500.

styles.name: nav-button
styles.usage: Navigation items, buttons and field labels.

styles.name: label-meta
styles.usage: Labels, badges and metadata. Use 500 for long metadata lines, 600 for short labels.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code panels and inline code. Prefer the project's existing monospace font.

styles.name: lesson-body-sm
styles.sample: Open the file and read the props first.
